business_context: Ingestion and transformation of massive, multi-tenant retail supply chain datasets suffered from Spark Catalyst planning bottlenecks on wide transformations and unoptimized queries in downstream analytical models.
summary_angle: Data Engineer specializing in retail supply chain ETL and distributed processing on Azure Databricks

phase_1_ingestion.daily_activity: Constructing programmatic REST API services to securely ingest, validate, and parse complex client ERP JSON payloads and flat files.

phase_2_storage.daily_activity: Routing standardized ERP payloads into cloud lake storage while automating cloud infrastructure provisioning with strict security controls.
native_tools: Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2)
swappable_categories: IaC & Cloud Storage (AWS S3, CloudFormation, GCP Cloud Storage)

phase_3_transformation.phase_name: Distributed Data Processing & Catalyst Plan Optimization
phase_3_transformation.daily_activity: Engineering distributed pipelines to cleanse, deduplicate, and merge retail datasets, eliminating Spark Catalyst planning overhead by consolidating iterative column operations into unified single-pass DataFrames.
key_optimizations: Eliminated Spark Catalyst planning overhead by consolidating iterative casting/enrichment into single-pass operations
Eliminated unnecessary repartitioning and tuned partition boundaries
swappable_categories: Distributed Compute (Apache Spark, dbt, EMR, Dataproc)

phase_4_orchestration_and_modeling.daily_activity: Orchestrating multi-tiered batch DAGs, tracking job health via cloud monitoring, and tuning downstream data warehouse models through query profiling and partition pruning.

phase_5_serving_and_bi.phase_name: Self-Service Analytics Views (SUPPRESS IF ROLE IS PURE BACKEND DE)
phase_5_serving_and_bi.daily_activity: Designing enterprise analytical models and views connecting Snowflake to business intelligence tools for stakeholder consumption.

tech_stack: Azure (ADLS Gen2, Databricks, Key Vault, Monitor, RBAC)
